summary: All 19 authored World Cup Hub components now own product-specific token bindings that target declared anatomy and states, and all 28 product primitives resolve exactly to an authored component, an anatomy part, or one of three approved scope/accessibility waivers. The fixture-led navigation, schedule scan, selectedMatchId rail, prediction persistence, item-level moderation, and provenance contracts were clarified without adding generic components. Authored specs no longer receive compiler family token defaults, and strict validation records authored token provenance plus primitive reconciliation.
decisions: Every llm-authored component must provide a non-empty tokens map with at least one declared anatomy target and one declared state target; values must reference emitted --ds-* tokens.

The component compiler uses authored token input exclusively for llm-authored contracts and labels it token_provenance=authored-input. Generated family defaults remain available only to non-authored baseline components.

The 28 product primitives are reconciled by exact source name. Component and anatomy mappings must target authored contracts and real parts; waivers require kind, replacement components, decision source, and approved status.

Match card is represented by match-ticker.match-ticker-item rather than a standalone card wall. Confidence badge, poll option, news note, and favorite selector are authored anatomy extensions instead of new components.

Bracket preview is deferred from the fixture-led group-stage release in favor of standings and result summaries. Toast and modal dialog are replaced by persistent inline status and contextual rail/ledger surfaces.

Top navigation uses ordinary landmark links with aria-current, while date/group/team/status controls remain fixture filters. selectedMatchId is the shared context key across ticker, schedule, detail, prediction, result, discussion, and composer.

Prediction persistence now models saving, saved, save-error rollback, confidence provenance, and rounded probability totals. Moderation states are explicitly scoped to opinion items, and provenance keeps data mode, verification, freshness, update time, and timezone as separate axes.

risks: The checked-in strict component gate remains red until Ontology Compiler regenerates projects/world-cup-hub/build/system/components/component_specs.json; that artifact still contains the pre-change family defaults and no authored-input provenance.

Repository-wide validate-agent-team still reports unrelated concurrent owners' stale artifact hashes. This handoff supersedes the component-scope paths, while the remaining paths require later handoffs from their owners.
The approved bracket-preview waiver is specific to the fixture-led group-stage release and must be reopened when knockout bracket exploration enters product scope.
Authored maps reference the current emitted --ds-* names. Ontology Compiler must rerun emitted-token resolution after token regeneration and may not substitute raw values or family defaults.
No application UI, runtime-theme.css, component_runtime.py, production_verifier.py, or generated system artifact was modified in this component-author stage.
